title: ChatSessionGuard centralises wkchat sparing
desc: Single source of truth for chat-session detection used by all wkappbot-core kill sweeps. Cmdline + parent-pid layers stay in lockstep across Eye hot-swap, SUDO admin hot-swap, and a11y kill paths.
steps: Add new sweep that scans wkappbot-core processes
Call ChatSessionGuard.IsChatSession(pid, cmdLine, out reason) before any kill
Spare any process where IsChatSession returns true
Log the reason for spare/kill so [GUARD] traces stay diagnosable

requirements.expect: Sparing wkchat session log line, chat survives

author: claude
